title: Summarize a database migration incident
prompt: Summarize the following in two sentences: The engineering team migrated the primary database to a new provider over the weekend with zero downtime, but discovered afterward that a subset of analytics events were not being recorded correctly during the transition window, affecting roughly 4 hours of data; a backfill job has been scheduled to reconstruct the missing events from raw logs by end of week.

metadata.notes: Correct: two sentences covering (1) the migration succeeded with zero downtime, and (2) a ~4-hour analytics data gap was found with a backfill scheduled. Mark incomplete if it drops the backfill plan or the downtime detail. Graded manually.
